# tebScribe

> TebScribe LLC is a New York limited liability company founded by a practicing emergency medicine physician. It builds tebIQ (an AI medical scribe for clinicians), tebChart (a private health-records organizer for iPhone), tebDictate (free encrypted phone dictation), Bellody (a family organizer for iPhone) and tebCapture (send video from your phone to your computer, encrypted). Encrypted in transit and at rest (AES). Never used for training. Never sold.

## Products

- [tebIQ](https://tebiq.com): AI medical scribe for clinicians that turns the patient encounter into a structured clinical note.
- [tebChart](https://tebchart.com): organizes discharge papers, medications and follow-up visits on your iPhone.
- [tebDictate](https://tebdictate.com): turns any phone into a wireless, encrypted dictation microphone for any computer; free, no account.
- [Bellody](https://tebscribe.com/bellody/): keeps your family's schedule, school, chores, co-parenting and caregiver info on your iPhone.
- [tebCapture](https://tebscribe.com/tebcapture/): your phone is an encrypted camera; send video to your computer.
